topic: Ask for Review la app-review prompt merchant-facing (khong phai customer product-review)
statement: Theo tai lieu "Ask for Review" §Correction (2026-08-27), tinh nang Ask for Review la mot prompt merchant-facing yeu cau merchant danh gia/review chinh app tren Shopify App Store, hien thi sau khi merchant luu mot offer duoc tao boi AI Offer Assistant — khong phai mot yeu cau review san pham post-purchase huong toi khach hang cuoi nhu gia thuyet ban dau (gia thuyet ban dau da bi bac bo).

topic: Muc dich: thu thap App Store review/feedback dung luc, dieu huong merchant khong hai long sang support
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Purpose, muc dich cua tinh nang la thu thap App Store review va phan hoi rating thap vao dung thoi diem merchant vua co trai nghiem tao offer bang AI, va dieu huong merchant khong hai long sang support thay vi de ho de lai 1-star review cong khai.

topic: Trigger: overlay chi hien sau khi luu offer duoc tao boi AI
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Trigger (QVD-171), overlay rating full-screen chi hien sau khi luu mot offer, va chi khi offer session do duoc tao boi AI — bat ke merchant di thang tu buoc AI Summary toi 'Create offer', hay preview roi sua trong Editor truoc khi luu.

topic: Offer tao thu cong khong bao gio thay overlay
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Trigger (QVD-171), offer duoc tao thu cong (manually-created) khong bao gio thay overlay nay; hanh vi hien co/khong lien quan cua cac offer do khong thay doi.

topic: Co isAiGenerated duoc gan tai thoi diem tao draft, truoc save, va persist qua preview/edit
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Flagging mechanism, bat ky offer nao duoc tao ra tu mot AI prompt session deu duoc gan co `isAiGenerated` ngay tai thoi diem session do tao ra draft — truoc khi luu — va co nay phai duoc giu nguyen (persist) qua cac buoc preview/edit.

topic: isAiGenerated la sole gate quyet dinh overlay co hien hay khong
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Flagging mechanism, co `isAiGenerated` la dieu kien gate duy nhat (sole gate) quyet dinh overlay review co hien ra hay khong.

topic: Overlay buoc 1: illustration + cau hoi + 5-star selector
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 1), overlay gom mot illustration, cau hoi 'How was your AI offer creation experience?', va mot bo chon 5-star.

topic: Star selector mac dinh 5 sao
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 1), bo chon star mac dinh la 5 sao.

topic: Chon star hien ngay nhanh tuong ung
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 2), viec chon mot muc star se ngay lap tuc hien ra nhanh (branch) tuong ung voi muc do.

topic: Nhanh 5-star: tag AI, nut Rewrite, textarea editable
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 2, nhanh 5 sao), nhanh 5-star hien thi tag 'Generated with AI', nut 'Rewrite' de xoay vong noi dung review do AI viet, va mot textarea co the sua.

topic: Nut Copy and Share: copy clipboard 2s roi redirect App Store review modal
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 2, nhanh 5 sao), bam nut 'Copy & Share on App Store' se copy noi dung text vao clipboard (hien chu 'Copied!' trong 2 giay), sau do chuyen huong (redirect) merchant toi modal review cua App Store.

topic: Nhanh 1-4 star: textarea feedback + nut Send Feedback to Support
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 2, nhanh 1-4 sao), nhanh 1-4 sao hien thi mot textarea feedback cung nut 'Send Feedback to Support'.

topic: Submit 1-4 star feedback gui kem private note chua nguyen van AI prompt
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 3), khi submit feedback o muc 1-4 sao, feedback do duoc gui toi support team kem mot private note chua nguyen van AI prompt ma merchant da nhap trong session do, nham cho support context de phan biet ask-vs-generated.

topic: Dong overlay (x hoac sau hanh dong nhanh) tra ve danh sach offer
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Overlay flow (buoc 4), viec dong overlay (bam × hoac sau hanh dong cua mot trong hai nhanh) se dua merchant tro ve danh sach offer.

topic: Field isAiGenerated: boolean
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Persisted fields (QVD-171), field `isAiGenerated` duoc persist duoi dang boolean.

topic: Field reviewRating: int 1-5 hoac null
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Persisted fields (QVD-171), field `reviewRating` duoc persist duoi dang int trong khoang 1-5, hoac null.

topic: Field reviewAction: enum(copied, feedback_sent, dismissed) hoac null
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Persisted fields (QVD-171), field `reviewAction` duoc persist duoi dang enum gom dung 3 gia tri ('copied', 'feedback_sent', 'dismissed'), hoac null.

topic: 5 ten event duoc track
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Tracked events (QVD-171/173), co dung 5 ten event duoc track: `ai_review_prompt_shown`, `ai_review_star_selected`, `ai_review_copy_clicked`, `ai_review_feedback_sent`, `ai_review_dismissed`.

topic: Invariant: dung 1 terminal event moi session, neu khong se double-count metrics
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Tracked events (QVD-171/173), moi session chi duoc phep co dung mot terminal event (mot trong `copy_clicked` `feedback_sent` `dismissed`); neu fire nhieu hon mot terminal event, session do se bi dem lap (double-count) trong backend metrics.

topic: Terminal-event invariant la FE contract, BE khong enforce duoc
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Tracked events (QVD-171/173), rang buoc 'dung mot terminal event' la mot FE contract (QVD-173) ma backend khong co cach nao tu enforce — nghia la mot bug o FE tai diem nay se am tham lam sai lech (corrupt) du lieu analytics, khong chi gay loi hien thi UI.

topic: Event luu vao MongoDB trigger_analytics qua TriggerAnalytic model
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Backend storage (QVD-173), cac event duoc luu vao collection MongoDB `trigger_analytics` da co san, qua model `TriggerAnalytic`, voi session key = `offer_id` + `ai_offer_event_id`, va khong can model/migration moi.

topic: Metric tinh duoc: star distribution, view/response rate, time-to-close, copy rate, feedback rate
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Business Rules > Backend storage (QVD-173), cac metric duoc tinh tu du lieu luu tru nay gom: star distribution (lay rating cuoi cung cua session neu merchant doi rating), view rate, response rate, time-to-close, copy rate, va feedback rate.

topic: [Chua xac nhan PO/Dev] Kha nang isAiGenerated KHONG duoc gan nguoc khi manual offer sau do sua bang AI
statement: Theo tai lieu... §Edge Cases (manually-created offer later edited via AI assistant), tai lieu tu nhan day la mot suy luan CHUA xac nhan voi PO/Dev: co `isAiGenerated` nhieu kha nang KHONG duoc gan nguoc (retroactive) cho offer da tao thu cong roi sua bang AI assistant — suy tu viec co duoc mo ta la gan 'tai thoi diem session tao ra draft' — nhung tai lieu tu goi day la crux cua toan bo trigger condition cua tinh nang va can confirm PO/Dev tuong minh.
